summary: Phase 3 of 8 complete: landed the four propositional combinators of the Lambda-chain toolkit in Soundness.lean, in a new '## Lambda-Chain Toolkit (Lemma 4.9, ImpL)' section placed after Lemma 4.9 and before the impL-deferred section. mpAnd (A B) : (A and (A imp B)) imp B is built via cs5DerivUncurrySwap fed cs5DerivImpSelf (A.imp B) -- the Q imp (P imp R) shape cs5DerivUncurrySwap expects collapses to the identity exactly when Q = P.imp R. topBase (A B) : ((top imp A) and (A imp B)) imp B is built by currying mpAnd into A imp ((A imp B) imp B), composing with cs5DerivTopImpElim via transitivity, then uncurrying back. andMP is a 3-step andI+modus_ponens combinator over closed derivations. lambdaChain_step2 is built via two nested deductionTheorem discharges (of the conjunction X and (Y imp P), then of Z), mirroring the file's existing lemma4_7_i_ii/cs5DerivKdiaUncurrySwapSchema proof pattern exactly (context [Z, Hyp], andE1/andE2 projections, andI recombination, MP against the weakened hypothesis). mpAnd/topBase/andMP marked private; lambdaChain_step2 public per plan. All four proved sorry-free, zero new diagnostics. Module's remaining diagnostics unchanged from Phase 1's baseline: the impL sorry warning (now at line 1424, shifted by the new section) and the cut non-exhaustiveness error (now at line 1438) -- both expected and unowned by this phase. Sorry census unchanged at 41 (bash .claude/scripts/lean-sorry-census.sh Cslib). Deviation from plan's proof-shape hint: mpAnd and topBase were built by composing existing private cs5Deriv* combinators (cs5DerivUncurrySwap, cs5DerivCurry, cs5DerivImpTrans, cs5DerivTopImpElim) already present earlier in Soundness.lean, rather than raw DerivationTree terms via deductionTheorem+andE1/andE2+MP as the plan's proof-shape note suggested. The stated type signatures and public API are unchanged from the plan; only the internal proof term differs (shorter, reuses existing file-local toolkit, same idiom the file already uses elsewhere e.g. lemma4_2_bot's singleton case). This is not a settled-design reopening -- no Postmortem Constraint governs mpAnd/topBase's internal proof technique -- and does not affect Phase 4's call sites (mpAnd A B, topBase A B are consumed by signature only).
